hints.title: Extract X-Coordinates
hints.text: The vertical area depends exclusively on x-coordinates and is independent of y-coordinates.

hints.title: Sort X-Coordinates
hints.text: Sorting the x-coordinates places adjacent vertical boundaries consecutively.

hints.title: Find Maximum Gap
hints.text: Find the maximum difference between consecutive x-coordinates after sorting.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise difference checking takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting x-coordinates takes O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice that y-coordinates can be completely ignored.
